tasks.prompt:
Automated daily code review session (06:00 AWST). Review recent automation work and update lessons-learned.md.

Steps:
1. Run: git log --oneline -20 to see recent commits
2. Check the last entry date in docs/lessons-learned.md
3. Count commits since that date. If fewer than 3 new commits, output 'No significant new work since last review — skipping.' and stop.
4. Otherwise, find open PRs from worker sessions using GitHub MCP tools (search_pull_requests). For each open PR:
   a. Run /code-review --comment on the PR diff to post inline findings directly on GitHub
   b. Use effort level 'high' for thoroughness
5. After PR inline comments are posted, extract ACTIONABLE rules from the findings
6. Append a new dated section to docs/lessons-learned.md following the same format as existing entries (Rules, Observations, Gaps open)
7. Update docs/automation-scorecard.md if any new patterns are now live or parked
8. Run: python scripts/update_status.py
9. Create a feature branch: git checkout -b review/feedback-YYYY-MM-DD
10. Commit all changed files with message: 'review: automated quality feedback YYYY-MM-DD'
11. Push branch and raise a PR targeting master
12. Do NOT merge — wait for user approval

Be specific and direct. Rules must be actionable — not 'consider X' but 'always do X' or 'never do Y'.
